import random,time
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create,PolicyError
random.seed(503)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)];reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
for L,N in [(3,16000),(4,16000)]:
 S=set()
 while len(S)<N:
  x=tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(L))
  S.add(x)
 text=''.join('match('+','.join(names[i] for i in t)+') allow;' for t in S)
 p=parse_policy(text);t=time.time()
 try:im=create(text,reg,p);res=('ok',len(im['rows']))
 except Exception as e:res=(type(e).__name__,str(e))
 print(L,N,N*L,'time',round(time.time()-t,3),res)
